Flat Owner User Guide

Sign In

1Email
2Password
3Login
  1. Open ajowa.in/login, enter the registered flat-owner email address and password, then select Login.
  2. Use Forgot password if access needs to be reset.

Review Dues

1Balance summary
2Linked flats
3Bill actions
  1. The top cards summarize current balance, total due, and linked flats.
  2. Each flat section shows bill rows, due dates, paid amounts, pending balance, and payment availability.
  3. Select View breakdown to inspect charge components before making a payment.

Download Receipts

1Receipt list
2Open/download
  1. Use Receipts to confirm payments already recorded against the owner account.
  2. Filter or search when many receipts are listed, then download or open the receipt needed for records.

Read Notices

1Notice cards
2Attachments/status
  1. Notices show society announcements, attachments, priority, and publish dates.
  2. Pinned or recent items should be reviewed first.

Raise Service Requests

1Ticket overview
2New request
3Ticket status
  1. Open Service Requests to track existing tickets and their current status.
  2. Select New request to report an issue for a linked flat or common area.

Create A New Request

1Flat/location
2Issue details
3Submit
  1. Choose the flat or location, select the service category, add a clear title, and describe the issue.
  2. Attach photos when helpful, then submit the request for society/service-team action.

Use Gate QR Access

1QR pass
2Linked flat details
  1. The QR page shows the resident access pass linked to active flats.
  2. Keep the QR visible for guard scanning and refresh the page if the code has expired.

Manage Profile

1Personal details
2Linked flats
3Visibility/settings
  1. Profile contains contact details, linked flat information, photo, and resident visibility settings.
  2. Keep phone, email, profession, and emergency information up to date.

Notification Settings

1Channels
2Save changes
  1. Choose email, SMS, WhatsApp, or browser notification preferences where available.
  2. Use these settings to keep bill, notice, and service updates reaching the right channel.

Book Amenities

1Booking list
2New booking
  1. Amenity bookings show upcoming and past reservations for linked flats.
  2. Use New booking when the society has bookable facilities enabled.
